102-progress.name: Captain Danuvin
102-progress.text: Have you collected 8 paws from those treacherous Gnolls yet?
102-progress.title: Patrolling Westfall

117-progress.name: Grimbooze Thunderbrew
117-progress.text:
Hurry, my friend, move with haste 
In order for our rich lager to taste
More like beer and less like stew,
Hops are needed to make the brew.
117-progress.title: Thunderbrew

132-progress.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
132-progress.text: Good to see you back, $N.  What did Wiley have to say for himself?
132-progress.title: The Defias Brotherhood

1338-progress.name: Furen Longbeard
1338-progress.text:
A letter from the dwarven lands?  I wonder who would call from so far to the north...

Please, let me see the order.
1338-progress.title: Stormpike's Order

135-progress.name: Master Mathias Shaw
135-progress.text: What business do you have with me?  I am a very busy man. . .
135-progress.title: The Defias Brotherhood

151-progress.name: Verna Furlbrow
151-progress.text: Old Blanchy is on her last leg.  Did you happen to find any oats for her?
151-progress.title: Poor Old Blanchy

153-progress.name: Scout Galiaan
153-progress.text: Bring me 15 red leather bandanas and I'll pay you well.
153-progress.title: Red Leather Bandanas

1638-complete.name: Harry Burlguard
1638-complete.text:
Oh ho!  Have a drink with me, lass.  You look tough on the outside, but let's see if your gut can handle a few mugs of the Pig and Whistle's strongest!!

Or... were you here for a lesson?
1638-complete.title: A Warrior's Training

1665-progress.name: Harry Burlguard
1665-progress.text: I saw your fight with Bartleby.  Nicely done!  Did you get his mug?
1665-progress.title: Bartleby's Mug

217-progress.name: Captain Rugelfuss
217-progress.text: Grawmug and his two guards, Gnasher and Brawler, are still alive.  Your mission is not complete until all 3 have been brought to death.  The Dwarven empire is counting on you, $N.
217-progress.title: In Defense of the King's Lands

22-progress.name: Salma Saldean
22-progress.text: All I need for my famous meat pie are 8 Goretusk Livers!
22-progress.title: Goretusk Liver Pie

267-progress.name: Captain Rugelfuss
267-progress.text: Do you have 8 Trogg Stone Teeth to show me?  If not, there is still work to be done, $N.
267-progress.title: The Trogg Threat

307-progress.name: Mountaineer Stormpike
307-progress.text: Do you have that Miners' Gear, $N?
307-progress.title: Filthy Paws

353-progress.name: Mountaineer Stormpike
353-progress.text: You come all the way from Stormwind?  I hear it's getting dicey down there in the human lands, with brigands and orcs running about.  A perfect place for a $c to prove their worth!
353-progress.title: Stormpike's Delivery

36-progress.name: Salma Saldean
36-progress.text: I'm going to miss that Verna Furlbrow so much.  I don't suppose you happened to see her on your way here?
36-progress.title: Westfall Stew

416-progress.name: Mountaineer Kadrell
416-progress.text: Hail, $N.  How goes the rat catching?
416-progress.title: Rat Catching

418-progress.name: Vidra Hearthstove
418-progress.text: I'm all ready to start cooking, do you have the ingredients for me?
418-progress.title: Thelsamar Blood Sausages

5545-progress.name: Supervisor Raelen
5545-progress.text: That deadline isn't getting any further away, $c. Please hurry and collect those bundles of wood.
5545-progress.title: A Bundle of Trouble

64-progress.name: Farmer Furlbrow
64-progress.text: Don't suppose you were able to get my watch?
64-progress.title: The Forgotten Heirloom

6661-progress.name: Monty
6661-progress.text: Yarrr... Swabby, what be takin' ye so long?
6661-progress.title: Deeprun Rat Roundup

6662-progress.name: Nipsy
6662-progress.text:
<Nipsy puts his index finger through one of the air holes in the carton.>

Alive and kicking... and just in time!
6662-progress.title: Me Brother, Nipsy

71-progress.name: Guard Thomas
71-progress.text: Hello, $N.  Have you discovered the fates of Rolf and Malakai?
71-progress.title: Report to Thomas

86585-complete.name: Captain Rugelfuss
86585-complete.text:
You found Ylva's body? Ah, the poor woman. She said she was going to show the troggs that Ironforge would never fall to their kind. She went looking for a few mountaineers who never returned from a patrol through trogg country. She was always too independent-minded to be cautious. Now we know what happened.

I'll take the banner back and make sure it's cleaned up and displayed. You should take her weapon. May it serve you well against the troggs.
86585-complete.title: Banner of the Fallen

86585-progress.name: Captain Rugelfuss
86585-progress.text: That banner looks like it's been in a war!
86585-progress.title: Banner of the Fallen

86614-accept.name: Unknown
86614-accept.text: <Among the fishing knickknacks in the debris are some rusty hooks, broken spools of wire, and a slightly corroded but ornate silver hair clip with the monogram "K.D.">
86614-accept.title: Silver of the Waves

86614-progress.name: Khara Deepwater
86614-progress.text: I have a lot of chores today, so can you keep it quick?
86614-progress.title: Silver of the Waves

86776-accept.name: Morhan Coppertongue
86776-accept.text:
Thelsamar's a great place to live, but we don't have all of the amenities of Ironforge. I'm always running out of bronze! I need more bronze if I'm going to keep making tools and kettles and pots!

I can tell you have a little experience at the forge. Think you could smelt me some bronze bars? I can pay you well for it!
86776-accept.title: Ingredients for the Forge

88-progress.name: Ma Stonefield
88-progress.text: Did you see her yet?  Did you get her?
88-progress.title: Princess Must Die!

91904-complete.name: Marcy Baker
91904-complete.text:
Thank you for your hard work, $N. There has been an uprising in bandits and thieves intercepting trade routes as of late. If you find other crates lying around, please bring them here and we'll handle the rest.

Here is your payment.
91904-complete.title: A Sealed Crate

91904-progress.name: Marcy Baker
91904-progress.text: Another delivery! Fantastic. Set it over by the pile and we can discuss your compensation.
91904-progress.title: A Sealed Crate

96394-progress.name: Afadra Dunwall
96394-progress.text: I don't have time for ghouls and ghosts. I have a job to do down here.
96394-progress.title: The Restless Dead

96395-accept.name: Unknown
96395-accept.text:
The... Thane... my mighty... Thane... he... needs to... rest.

Please... help him... help him... rest...

Consumed... by... ancient... grudge... No... rest...
96395-accept.title: An Ancient Grudge

96395-complete.name: Unknown
96395-complete.text:
My... Thane... he... rests... yes... rest.

Thank... you...

I... rest...
96395-complete.title: An Ancient Grudge

96403-progress.name: Thom Filch
96403-progress.text: <Thom appears to absentmindedly rub his hands together as he looks at you.>
96403-progress.title: Important Heirlooms

98247-complete.name: Marcy Baker
98247-complete.text:
You have arrived at the right place! I am happy to mark you down as one of our affiliates. No contracts to sign and no commitments to weigh you down. All we ask of you is your diligence to assist in completing or returning any of our deliveries you find on your travels.

When you do so, you will be compensated with Merchant's Favor that will allow you to purchase goods and services we offer here. In fact, here's a little bit to get you started.

Now, do you happen to have the crate this came from?
98247-complete.title: Shipping Label

98247-progress.name: Marcy Baker
98247-progress.text: Ah, greetings! How can I be of assistance?
98247-progress.title: Shipping Label

98423-accept.name: Unknown
98423-accept.text: Inside of the vault you find a tablet detailing the terms of a peace treaty between the Bronzebeard and Wildhammer dwarf clans. It appears to date back to time period just after the War of the Three Hammers, and is very likely a notable piece of dwarven history. The king of Ironforge would no doubt be interested in this artifact.
98423-accept.title: The Treaty of Understanding

98423-progress.name: King Magni Bronzebeard
98423-progress.text: What have you brought from the depths, $c.
98423-progress.title: The Treaty of Understanding
